properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Declared dependency bcprov-jdk15on:1.55 ships AES. The wallet's live AES use flows through the extlibj binary dependency (AESUtil payload encryption, invoked from 11 confirmed PBKDF2-object call sites) and the BIP47 ECDH shared secret is wrapped as an AES key (SecretPoint.java:47 generateSecret("AES")).
